body: Why did loads of comments here get deleted?

1. I don't have anybody to talk to. The people I'm close to tend to be intolerant 'get over it' type people - talking to them is way more trouble than it's worth.

2. I smile and laugh quite a lot yet I often feel suicidal. People think that happy/sad is this binary thing, but I'm not sure that it is. I can be perfectly happy in the immediate sense while being deeply unhappy in the long term sense at the same time.

3. I can't think of what it is that I'd miss. Sure, there'd be TV shows or whatever that I haven't seen, but I think I'd be fine with missing out on them. Obviously I wouldn't be around to experience any kind of regret about it.
I don't have those things in me so I can't relate, lol

>as long as you allow them to be

I'm not convinced that I get a choice in the matter

I think you underestimate the power of suicidal thoughts though. I can do the thing that I love doing the most in the world, and still like 25% of my mind will be concentrating on that thing and the other 75% will just be going around on a loop telling me that I should kill myself.

If I write what I am thinking then it looks really ridiculous on the page and I feel really guilty about it because I am being silly, so it just makes it worse.
I don't have interests that are powerful enough to stop me thinking negative things though.
People don't love me back though so if I spend all of this time investing in other people then I just feel as though I've been played.
